# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Mg.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Energy minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Setup for elastic constant calculation
change_box all triclinic

# Calculate elastic constants
fix 3 all box/relax aniso 0.0

# Define the elastic constants calculation
fix 1 all deform 1 x scale 1.000001 y scale 1.000001 z scale 1.000001 remap x
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Output elastic constants
variable C11 equal "(c_thermo_press[1]-f_3[1])/0.000001"
variable C22 equal "(c_thermo_press[2]-f_3[2])/0.000001"
variable C33 equal "(c_thermo_press[3]-f_3[3])/0.000001"
variable C12 equal "0.5*(c_thermo_press[1]+c_thermo_press[2])"
variable C13 equal "0.5*(c_thermo_press[1]+c_thermo_press[3])"
variable C23 equal "0.5*(c_thermo_press[2]+c_thermo_press[3])"

# Calculate bulk modulus using Voigt average
variable K equal "(${C11}+${C22}+${C33}+2*(${C12}+${C13}+${C23}))/9"

# Output results
print "Bulk Modulus = ${K} GPa"

# Write to log file
log elastic.log

boundary p p p

minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Set up elastic calculation
change_box all triclinic

# Calculate elastic constants
fix 3 all box/relax aniso 0.0
fix_modify 3 temp 0.0

# Define elastic constants calculation
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable atomvolume equal vol/atoms

variable d1 equal -${up}*xz
variable d2 equal -${up}*yz
variable d3 equal -${up}*xy
variable d4 equal -${up}*xx
variable d5 equal -${up}*yy
variable d6 equal -${up}*zz

variable p2 equal pyy
variable p3 equal pzz

variable p6 equal pxy

    x delta 0 0 ${d1} &
    y delta 0 ${d2} 0 &
    z delta ${d3} 0 0
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Output stresses
print "Stress components: ${p1} ${p2} ${p3} ${p4} ${p5} ${p6}"

# Calculate bulk modulus components
variable C11 equal ${p1}/${up}
variable C22 equal ${p2}/${up}
variable C33 equal ${p3}/${up}

# Voigt bulk modulus = (C11 + C22 + C33)/9

# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Mg.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Set up elastic calculation
change_box all triclinic

# Define variables for strain increments
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Output settings
variable len equal 6
variable i loop ${len}

# Elastic constants calculation
fix 3 all box/relax aniso 0.0

# Initial minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Store initial box dimensions
variable tmp equal "lx"
variable L0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal "ly"
variable W0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal "lz"
variable H0 equal ${tmp}

# Define deformation matrix components
variable d1 equal ${up}
variable d2 equal ${up}
variable d3 equal ${up}
variable d4 equal ${up}
variable d5 equal ${up}
variable d6 equal ${up}

# Calculate stress-strain for each component
label loop

  # Strain application
  if "$i == 1" then &
    "change_box all x delta 0 ${d1} xy delta ${d6} xz delta ${d5} remap units box"
  if "$i == 2" then &
    "change_box all y delta 0 ${d2} yz delta ${d4} remap units box"
  if "$i == 3" then &
    "change_box all z delta 0 ${d3} remap units box"
  if "$i == 4" then &
    "change_box all yz delta ${d4} remap units box"
  if "$i == 5" then &
    "change_box all xz delta ${d5} remap units box"
  if "$i == 6" then &
    "change_box all xy delta ${d6} remap units box"

  # Minimization
  minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

  # Output stress components
  variable tmp equal pxx
  variable pxx${i} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal pyy
  variable pyy${i} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal pzz
  variable pzz${i} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal pxy
  variable pxy${i} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal pxz
  variable pxz${i} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal pyz
  variable pyz${i} equal ${tmp}

  # Print results
  print "Strain ${i}"
  print "Stress tensor:"
  print "${pxx${i}} ${pxy${i}} ${pxz${i}}"
  print "${pxy${i}} ${pyy${i}} ${pyz${i}}"
  print "${pxz${i}} ${pyz${i}} ${pzz${i}}"

  # Reset box to unstrained state
  if "$i == 1" then &
    "change_box all x delta 0 ${down} xy delta ${down} xz delta ${down} remap units box"
  if "$i == 2" then &
    "change_box all y delta 0 ${down} yz delta ${down} remap units box"
  if "$i == 3" then &
    "change_box all z delta 0 ${down} remap units box"
  if "$i == 4" then &
    "change_box all yz delta ${down} remap units box"
  if "$i == 5" then &
    "change_box all xz delta ${down} remap units box"
  if "$i == 6" then &
    "change_box all xy delta ${down} remap units box"

  next i
jump SELF loop

# Print final elastic tensor components
print "Elastic Tensor Components (GPa):"
print "C11 = ${pxx1}"
print "C22 = ${pyy2}"
print "C33 = ${pzz3}"
print "C44 = ${pyz4}"
print "C55 = ${pxz5}"
print "C66 = ${pxy6}"

# Calculate bulk modulus using Voigt average
variable bulk_modulus equal (${pxx1}+${pyy2}+${pzz3})/9.0
print "Bulk Modulus (GPa) = ${bulk_modulus}"

# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Mg.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Set up elastic calculation
change_box all triclinic

# Calculate elastic constants
fix 3 all box/relax aniso 0.0
fix_modify 3 energy yes

# Define elastic constants calculation
compute elastic all elastic/atom
compute stress all stress/atom NULL

# Output elastic constants
thermo_style custom step temp pe press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz lx ly lz xy xz yz
thermo 1

# Run for elastic constants
run 0

# Compute elastic constant tensor for a crystal
#
# Written by Aidan Thompson (Sandia, athomps@sandia.gov)
#
#  This script uses the following three commands:
#
# displace_atoms command: 
#   used to translate atoms in a periodic cell by a prescribed amount
#
# change_box command: 
#   used to change the box dimensions by a prescribed amount
#   The units of the change are determined by "units" command
#
# variable command: 
#   used to help define the displacement magnitude and changes
#   The equations for the variables are described in:
#
#   Sprik, M., Impey, R. W., & Klein, M. L. (1986). 
#   Second-order elastic constants for the Lennard-Jones solid. 
#   Physical Review B, 33(10), 6872.
#
#   Elastic constants are computed by measuring changes in stress 
#   from deformations.
#

include /root/lammps/examples/ELASTIC/potential.mod

variable delta equal ${up}
include /root/lammps/examples/ELASTIC/potential.mod

units metal
dimension 3

variable L0 equal lx
variable tmp equal ly
variable ly0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal lz
variable lz0 equal ${tmp}

variable down equal -${up}

# Output settings

variable dir equal 4

variable C12all equal ${C12}
variable C13all equal ${C13}
variable C23all equal ${C23}

print "C33 = ${C33all}"
print "C12 = ${C12all}"
print "C13 = ${C13all}"
print "C23 = ${C23all}"

# Displacement module for elastic constant calculation

clear
box tilt large
read_data Al.data

variable P0 equal press

variable up equal 1.0e-6

variable tmp equal ly
variable ly0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal lz

variable s2 equal "(v_delta/v_ly0)*pyy"
variable s3 equal "(v_delta/v_lz0)*pzz"

change_box all x delta 0 ${delta} remap units box
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
